messages:
elaine.marketing: Quick ask for eng-runtime: were closing the launch post and need validated numbers for three traffic profiles: interactive-demo, batch-embed, long-chat. Run each profile against open-xxl fp16 and int8-quant, capture p50/p95/p99, median tokens/sec, delta cold-vs-warm (ms), and a tiny sample of raw outputs (8 responses per model/profile). Include a one-paragraph note on sampling bias for the slide. Target: Thu EOD. Minimal artifacts only please.

mike.runtime: Got it. Clarify infra: do you want hosted(cheap) numbers only or hosted + one dedicated run for the capacity claim? Also: synthetic workload shapes or replay real demo traces?

elaine.marketing: Hosted numbers for the headline. Add one dedicated run (single node) to back the SLA note. Use synthetic workloads that mimic our demo traces but add ~10% longer tails for chat profiles so were conservative. 3 runs per profile/variant. Seed for repeatability.

nora.qa: Methodology suggestions: warmup=12 longest-context sequences, steady until 12k tokens or 4 minutes per run (whichever first). Use seed=2026. Collect GPU util, mem, kv_cache_hit_rate, and stderr for slow traces. If p99_interactive > 1500ms ping me. Also capture token timestamps for the single slowest trace per run.

infra-bot: Job scheduled: bench-20260315-441 (queued on eng-runtime pool). ETA ~3h.

mike.runtime: Plan + command Ill run:
```
./ci/bench.sh \n  --profile {interactive-demo,batch-embed,long-chat} \n  --model open-xxl \n  --quant {fp16,int8} \n  --warmup 12 \n  --steps 12000 \n  --seed 2026 \n  --adaptive-batching on \n  --max-batch 12 \n  --kv-cache on \n  --out-dir /artifacts/marketing/launch_metrics/1762638888/
```
Docker image: redwood/runtime:2026-03-15-rc1. Ill run 3 repeats per combo and emit CSV with fields: profile,model,quant,var_run,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens_per_sec,gpu_util_pct,kv_cache_pct. Outputs.jsonl will contain up to 8 samples per variant. ETA: Thu early afternoon. If I'm tight on time Ill drop samples to 5 per variant and note it.

elaine.marketing: Fine to drop to 5 if needed, call it out. Please also dump the exact docker+flags into docker_info.txt and paste the run command in runbook.txt so we can reproduce in the appendix.

nora.qa: Add: set LOG_LEVEL=info and capture slow-trace stderr (gzip). Ill validate quality samples for obvious hallucinations; we need at least 1 example per profile that looks good for the press screenshot.

mike.runtime: Copy. Ill upload CSV, outputs.jsonl, docker_info.txt, runbook.txt, heatmap_{profile}.png to /artifacts/marketing/launch_metrics/1762638888/ and post a summary here when done. If p99>1500ms on interactive Ill include single-token timestamp trace and escalate.

elaine.marketing: Awesome, thank you. :pray: Small ask: add a one-liner we can paste under the chart about what cold means and how we warmed up (one sentence).

mike.runtime: Will do. Pinging when artifacts are uploaded.
